## Play: Draw the Boundary

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Draw the Boundary (10 to 20 min)" icon="false"}
How does a computer learn to predict which machines will fail? Draw the [decision boundary]{.term} yourself and find out why a model with zero [training error]{.term} can still fail on new machines. The game previews [machine learning]{.term}, [overfitting]{.term}, and the reason engineers hold back test data.
